blocks.title: Fossil fuels
blocks.text: Petroleum (crude oil yani kacha tel), coal (koyla) aur natural gas (qudrati gas) ko mila kar fossil fuels kehte hain.

Crude oil zameen ke neeche ke reservoirs (zakhiron) se nikala jata hai aur bare plants mein fractional distillation se refine (saaf) kiya jata hai. Petroleum ke major products (bari cheezein) naphtha, gasoline, kerosene aur diesel hain.

Methane (CH₄) natural gas ka sab se bara component (hissa) hai; is ke saath ethane, propane aur butane bhi mili hoti hain. Methane zyada tar ammonia (jo fertilizers yani khaad mein use hoti hai) aur methanol (jo solvents aur fuel mein use hota hai) banane mein kaam aati hai. Coal ab pehle jitna useful (mufeed) nahi raha, lekin jahan is ke reserves (zakhire) zyada hain wahan ab bhi petrochemicals ka raw material (kacha maal) hai. Coal ka primary (sab se bara) use benzene, toluene aur xylene obtain karna (hasil karna) hai, jo dyes (rang), resins aur explosives (dhamaka khez cheezein) banane ke liye zaruri hain.

blocks.title: Keep in Mind (yaad rakhein)
blocks.text: Fossil fuels energy ke bohat efficient (achhe) sources hain, lekin in ke combustion (jalne) se carbon dioxide (CO₂) jaisi greenhouse gases banti hain. Is se air pollution (hawa ki aaloodgi), global warming aur climate change (mausam ki tabdeeli) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Benzene, toluene aur xylene kis fossil fuel se milte hain, aur kis kaam aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Coal se; yeh dyes, resins aur explosives banane mein use hote hain.

items: Fossil fuels: petroleum, coal, natural gas.
Natural gas (zyada tar CH₄): ammonia aur methanol; coal: benzene, toluene, xylene.
Jalne se CO₂: air pollution, global warming, climate change.
